next.reason: 1985: "In level 1, literal-1, literal-2, and literal-3, and the data items referenced by identifier-3, identifier-4, and identifier-5 must be one character"; 2023: "No level subsets; one-character limit kept only for CHARACTERS phrase: "literal-3 shall be one character in length" (SR-14.9.22.3-7)". The 1985 rule is a level-1 subset limit requiring one-character INSPECT operands. 2023 has no subsets and requires one character only with the CHARACTERS phrase.
